title: The home globe: a toy planet
kaylee: Her globe is a little toy planet now: candy trees, snowy peaks, a pink whale, sailboats and a rainbow stand on it, clouds hang over its edge, a sleepy baby moon goes round it, and every one of them does something when she pokes it.
questions: How full should the world be: more toys, just right, or fewer?
The baby moon flies across the front of the globe on its way round. Keep it, or keep it off the face?
